description: DB integration: EE migrations apply on a migrated schema — inserting a user with user_type='service' succeeds and 'robot' fails the CHECK; service_principals, via columns, service_principal_limit and permission rows exist. On a CE-only migrated schema, inserting user_type='service' fails the CHECK

DB integration: EE agent migration on seeded agents (one active, one inactive) yields service users with is_inactive mirroring agents.active, service_user_id backfilled, service_principals rows; rerun is a no-op; getLicenseUsage.used drops by the agent count

DB integration: Pro tenant at its seat limit can still create an API principal and an MCP agent (seat usage unchanged); at the service-principal limit both fail with SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_LIMIT_REACHED and nothing is inserted

Unit: limit resolution — hosted uses tenant override else 10; appliance uses the verified service_principals claim, ignores tenants.service_principal_limit, and falls back to 10 when the claim is missing or the token is invalid

DB integration: deactivating a principal sets is_inactive, deactivates its keys, and a previously minted mcp_agent session key fails validateApiKey immediately; reactivation is limit-checked and old keys stay inactive

DB integration: deleting a principal referenced by a ticket and mcp_agent_audit archives it (audit kept, IdP binding cleared, hidden from list, subject rebindable to a new agent); deleting an unused principal hard-deletes it; the archived principal no longer counts toward the limit
Unit: user-type predicates truth table for internal/client/service/unknown
Integration: authenticateUser rejects a service user even after its hashed_password is set to a real valid hash (proves the gate is not the locked password); omitted userType is rejected
Integration: signIn callback returns false for a service user on credentials and an OAuth provider, and no sessions row, last_login update or login-success record is written
Unit: checkTrackedSession, requireLiveSession and sessionAuthMiddleware reject a token whose stored user type is service; Next middleware sends it to sign-in
Integration: mobile — issueMobileOtt/exchange/refresh, Apple sign-in via a linked identity, and IAP restore all refuse a service user (and an inactive internal user)
Integration: createApiKey refuses a service owner for every purpose (including mobile_session, mcp_user); EE issueServicePrincipalKey creates an active purpose='service' key that validates
Integration: adminChangeUserPassword, createResetToken, completePasswordReset and setNewPassword refuse a non-interactive target; deleteUser/invite/reactivate actions refuse it too
Integration: REST GET /api/v1/tickets with a service principal key succeeds under its MSP role and 403s without the permission; a client-owned key is still rejected

Integration: act-as validation — principal without allow_act_as → 403 ACT_AS_NOT_ALLOWED; client or inactive or service target → 422 ACT_AS_INVALID_TARGET; header on a human-owned key → 400 ACT_AS_NOT_SUPPORTED
Integration: act-as RBAC intersection — principal allowed but act-as human lacks permission → 403; human allowed but principal lacks it → 403; both allowed → 200
DB integration: POST time entry as a service principal without act-as → 422 ACT_AS_REQUIRED; with act-as → user_id and created_by are the human and created_via_principal_id is the principal

DB integration: principal creates a ticket as itself (entered_by = principal, assigned_to = human ok, ticket_audit_logs actor_type service_principal); assigned_to or added resource = a service user → 422 HUMAN_WORK_ASSIGNEE_INVALID

DB integration: interaction create and schedule entry create by a principal with no assignees and no act-as → ACT_AS_REQUIRED (no self-booking); explicit service assignee rejected; with act-as the via column is stamped
DB integration: time-sheet approve and time-entry approve by a bare principal → ACT_AS_REQUIRED; with act-as approved_by is the human and approved_via_principal_id is stamped
DB integration: project task create/update with assigned_to or task resource = service user is rejected
DB integration: a legacy ticket whose assigned_to is a migrated (now service) agent user can still have its status changed; changing assigned_to to that user is rejected
DB integration: act-as ticket update writes ticket_audit_logs actor_type='user', actor_user_id = human, via_principal_user_id = principal; auditLog details carry via
Unit: MCP call with act_as_user_id forwards X-Alga-Act-As on selfFetch and writes mcp_agent_audit.act_as_user_id

Unit: two different keys for one principal consume the same sp:<id> bucket; rateLimitConfig resolves per-key row → principal override → Pro default; CE enforce honors the context override; override above ceiling rejected
DB integration: getAllUsers/getAllUsersBasic and UserService list exclude service users by default and include them with includeServicePrincipals; Settings → Users MSP tab data excludes them
DB integration: REST UserService.update cannot change user_type to/from service; REST UserService.create rejects 'service' and blocks an internal user at the seat limit
Unit: comment author resolution and authorization-subject normalizers return service for a service user (never client/contact or internal)
Unit (static guard): no non-test source contains a raw `user_type !== 'client'` or `=== 'client' ? 'client' : 'internal'` pattern outside packages/types predicates
Component: Service principals tab lists principals with kind badges and display names, shows 'x of y', disables New at the limit; create dialog saves roles and act-as
Component: Manage keys dialog shows the new key once, revokes and rotates
Component: AccountManagement and LicenseManagementPage render the service-principal usage row; MCP settings shows the shared limit
Component: ticket activity and time-entry detail render '<human> via <principal>'; service-authored comment renders Service badge
Component: API keys admin list shows principal name + Service badge for principal-owned keys

DB integration (EE): on an essentials tenant createServicePrincipal (api) and createAgent both fail with TIER_ACCESS_DENIED and insert nothing; a pre-existing principal's key still authenticates while reactivation and new key issuance are refused

Component: below Pro the Service principals tab and MCP agent create show the upgrade notice, grandfathered principals list with deactivate/delete only, and the license page row reads 'Available on Pro'

Unit (CE build): with the oss entry, buildAuthenticatedApiContext rejects a key owned by a non-internal, non-client user, getKeyGateReason rejects it, and the @enterprise service-principal component stubs render null
Unit (static guard): no file outside ee/, packages/product-service-principals/ or packages/ee/ references service_principals, X-Alga-Act-As, the 'service' key purpose or the entitlement constant
Integration (EE): service-principal server actions refuse callers without an interactive internal session or without service_principal permission

DB integration: principal posts a ticket comment with no visibility → stored internal; explicit is_internal=false without act-as → 422 ACT_AS_REQUIRED and nothing stored; with act-as → public comment authored by the human with created_via_principal_id; a client-portal user's public comment is unaffected
Unit: authorization kernel joint-subject evaluation — allows only when both subjects allow; record-level rules evaluated for each subject; a single-subject call behaves exactly as today

DB integration (CE rule): a ticket comment by a non-interactive author with no visibility is stored internal; explicit is_internal=false throws HumanWorkOwnerRequiredError('is_internal') and stores nothing; client-portal and inbound-email comments unaffected

DB integration (CE guard): assertHumanWorkAssignee rejects a non-interactive id as ticket assignee, ticket resource, schedule assignee, time-entry owner, time-sheet approver and interaction owner; writes that default the owner to a non-internal caller throw HumanWorkOwnerRequiredError; internal ids pass
